title: Arundhuti G takes charge of HR at Fitsol
summary: Arundhuti G has joined Fitsol as head of human resources, bringing 16 years of experience across HR business partnering, leadership hiring, employee engagement, compliance and organisational development. She joins Fitsol from Prozo, where she served as senior director – human resources from April
